description: This source file defines a configuration class and related methods for integrating the Fal AI Flux Pro v1.1-ultra text-to-image model into a larger AI generation framework. It includes parameter mapping, request transformation, and response processing tailored for the specific model endpoint, as well as handling aspect ratio conversions and parameter support validation.
